title: Let the components be rearranged according to the width of the column
goal: Use container query to distinguish between wide-column cards and narrow-column cards in the same viewport.
summary: Two catalog card components appear on the same page. Narrow columns are used to place titles and entrances vertically, and wide columns are arranged horizontally.
tasks: Enable inline-size query for containers for .slot.
When the .slot width is at least 320px, let the internal .entry use Flex arrangement; when it is narrower, keep the top and bottom layout.

example.note: Specify the container first and then add conditional rules for its descendants. Condition checks container width.

hint: The selector within @container is written as .entry, and the container type is written as its parent .slot.
